venn.py.src:
chess = {"Ada", "Bo", "Cy"}
art = {"Bo", "Cy", "Di", "Eve"}
print("either:", sorted(chess | art))
print("both:", sorted(chess & art))
print("chess only:", sorted(chess - art))
print("art only:", sorted(art - chess))
print("just one:", sorted(chess ^ art))
